messages:
samir: seeing a spike of TLS handshake failures from eu-proxy -> payment-auth-eu in canary. errors show 'OCSP response missing' and clients abort. this started after last night's rotator run. anyone seen this after a rotation?

michaela: @samir which backend and can you paste a quick log snippet?

samir: backend: payment-auth-eu. repro locally: `openssl s_client -connect proxy-eu:443 -status`
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
OCSP response: no response sent
---
SSL handshake failure: certificate verify failed
```

anne: are these client certs or server certs? OCSP stapling is server-side — could be proxy not stapling or not sending chain.

josh: proxy runs envoy 1.24, uses keystore-mount for cert artifacts. rotator uploaded new intermediate at ~02:11Z. rotator logs show one KMS unwrap failure around same time.

cert-rotator-bot: rotator run completed for payment-auth-eu at 2026-03-20T02:12Z. KMS unwrap failures: 1 (transient). New cert artifact published: v20260320-1.

anne: KMS unwrap failures during upload could result in incomplete chain being published (no OCSP staple). also recall we had an RBAC change to rotator-role last week — did that remove kms:Decrypt? @michaela can you check keystore role bindings?

michaela: checking iam logs... rotator-role-policy was edited 2026-03-19T21:00Z and indeed kms:Decrypt was removed from rotator-sa-eu. looks like an overly broad permission cleanup. opening a PR to restore.

samir: ok restoring perms should fix future rotations but current proxy still lacks stapled responses. short-term options: disable OCSP stapling on the envoy canary (lower cert strictness) or re-upload full chain artifact via maintenance path. both have tradeoffs.

josh: re-upload via maintenance key bypass requires audit approvals; it will produce KMS decrypt log entries which is what we need for post-fix traceability. disabling stapling reduces client security and may trigger app-level checks.

anne: escalate to oncall. we need: full audit trail (who changed RBAC), rotator logs, KMS logs, proxy tls logs, and keystore object versions. If we do maintenance re-upload, record the principal and create a policy exception in the ticket.

devsec-bot: Audit checklist generated: 1) collect proxy TLS logs (envoy access+tls), 2) rotator run logs, 3) KMS Decrypt logs for rotator-sa-eu, 4) IAM policy diff for rotator-role-policy, 5) keystore object version history. Tag incident: OCSP-STAPLE-2026-EU.

michaela: PR 4821 created to re-add kms:Decrypt for rotator-sa-eu, adding approvers @eng-security @eng-infra. attaching iam change diff and rotator log snippets.

samir: for mitigation I rolled the canary back to previous envoy config and cert artifact v20260318-3. handshake failure rate dropped ~95% in the last 10 minutes. monitoring continues.

eng-oncall: received. will monitor KMS metrics and keep the channel updated. if PR merges, schedule a controlled rotator run with smoke tests.

anne: action items for postmortem: 1) enforce RBAC change reviews with checklist (include KMS perms), 2) add KMS unwrap alerting tied to cert-rotator, 3) add automated OCSP stapling smoke test after rotation (envoy `-status` check), 4) update runbook to include maintenance re-upload flow + audit steps.

josh: I'll add the smoke test to deploy pipeline and create a canary gate that rejects cert artifacts that fail OCSP check.

samir: created INC-2026-147 for tracking and attached initial logs. thanks all. :thumbsup:
